preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or have control of the ________ address (0x3aB960dCf9359083DC126222c03bfB0d2A3C9b6b)
Attacker must hold some MemeFarm tokens to sell

exploit_hint: As owner or ________ address controller: 1) Use qwidji() to blacklist all other token holders, preventing them from selling. 2) Set sell taxes to 100% using setAllTaxes(). 3) Set yourself as fee-exempt using setlsExcIudeFromFee(). 4) Sell your tokens without paying fees while others cannot sell. 5) Alternatively, use changeRouterVeslon() to mint unlimited tokens to yourself.
